mysql-lab-server.name: MySQL lab server (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
mysql-lab-server.notes: The one machine of the mysql-lab (vms/labs/mysql-lab/): MySQL 8 with the lab database testdb (users and orders, a foreign key between them) and the account labuser / labpass, plus phpMyAdmin on Apache. From the host: phpMyAdmin at http://127.0.0.1:8088/phpmyadmin, MySQL at 127.0.0.1:3307 (bind-address 0.0.0.0 in the guest, reached through QEMU's NAT). ~/setup-mysql-lab.sh is also the reset: it drops testdb and loads the sample data again. Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image. Ported from qlab's mysql-lab.

post_install_run: mysql testdb -N -e 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users' | grep -qx 4
